reason: Add an optional session-authorized adaptive raster preview endpoint; existing display/read, durable image bytes and model inputs are unchanged.
compatibility: Existing file display schemas/endpoints remain unchanged. New strict DisplayImageRead/DisplayImage wire types are used only by display/image-preview; older Hosts retain explicit original-open fallback. Derivatives preserve EXIF orientation, RGB ICC and alpha; reject unsupported animation/color metadata rather than silently degrading it. No dependencies, lockfiles, CI versions or Host task lifecycle changes.
